name: task-complete
description: Ask whether a unit of work is actually finished. Built for agent loops that otherwise re-ask the model the same question until it agrees.

criteriaMet.instructions: Do the changes satisfy every acceptance criterion stated in the task?

verified.instructions: Does the test output show the relevant checks running and passing?

criteria.true: tests covering this change ran and passed
criteria.false: no test output, tests skipped, or failures present

inScope.instructions: Do the changes stay within what the task asked for, without unrelated edits?
